newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Swedish shares close down on failed bank merger.
newsitem.headline: Swedish shares close down on failed bank merger.

text.p: Swedish shares ended lower on Monday, following the failed merger discussions between banks Nordbanken and S-E-Banken as well as higher interest rates.
The exchange's general index fell 0.42 percent to 2,528.87 in turnover of 3.46 billion crowns.
Nordbanken and S-E-Banken dropped after announcing that merger negotiations ended without conclusion.
Nordbanken fell 7.5 crowns to 227.5 crowns after coming off its day lows of 210, while S-E-Banken fells five to 67.50.
Power group Sydkraft rose five to 139.5, despite radio reports saying its nuclear power plant Barseback will be shut.

The decision to phase out Swedish nuclear power did not affect steel and forestry companies much either, despite their arguments against a phase out on the grounds that it would increase energy prices and hurt them significantly.
"It is hard to calculate the effect with this little information," a trader said.
In general, the market was negatively affected by New York opening lower. In particular, drugs company Astra was hurt by its U.S. counterparts starting lower. The share fell 3.5 crowns to 342 crowns.
